title: The Base
note: This is the nature of the low, who have none of the qualities the earlier chapters stated or implied. So it comes after all of them.

couplets.plain: The base look just like people. We have never seen a likeness like it.
couplets.pm: In shape the base exactly match human beings. We have seen no such likeness between any other two kinds. Humans and the base share one form, so only the presence or absence of good qualities tells them apart.

links.quote: We have never seen a likeness like it

couplets.plain: The base are more fortunate than those who know what is good, for their hearts have no worries.
couplets.pm: The low are better off than those who know what is good for them, because they have no such worry. The good means fame, righteousness and wisdom, for this world, the next and liberation. Those who know them fret over doing too little, over obstacles, and over blame and sin. The low do wrong without a care. This is scorn.

couplets.plain: The base are like the gods, for they too do whatever they please.
couplets.pm: The gods and the base are of one kind. How? Like the gods, with no one to rule them, the base do whatever they want. The gods are high and the base are low, so this is blame in the shape of praise. They do as they like, with nothing to stop them.

links.quote: like the gods, for they too do whatever they please
links.reason: Mock praise: like the gods, they do whatever they please.

couplets.plain: When the low meet a lesser rogue, they outdo him and swagger.
couplets.pm: When a low man sees people whose wilful ways fall short of his own, he goes further than they do, shows off how far he has gone and swells with pride. Such people are called strays because they go wherever they want.

couplets.plain: Fear is all the good conduct of the low. Apart from that, there is a little, if there is something they want.
couplets.pm: If you see good conduct in the low, its cause is fear of harm from the ruler. Apart from that there may be a little, if it brings the wealth they crave. Mostly it is fear, a little is gain, and none comes by nature. Doing as they like is their nature, and proper conduct is not.

links.quote: Fear is all the good conduct of the low

couplets.plain: The base are like a drum being beaten, because they carry the secrets they hear to others and tell them.
couplets.pm: Because they carry the secrets they hear from place to place and tell others, the base are like a beaten drum. A secret is something told apart from others, because harm comes if it gets out. “Carry” shows it is a heavy load for them. A drum spreads everywhere what one hand has told it.

links.reason: Likens them to a drum, beating out loud whatever was told in trust.

links.quote: they carry the secrets they hear to others and tell them

couplets.plain: The base won’t shake off so much as their wet hands for anyone but those whose clenched fists can break their jaws.
couplets.pm: Unless you have a clenched fist that can crush their jaws, the base won’t even flick the wet from the hand they have just eaten with, though you beg. They give nothing to the weak and everything to those who torment them.

links.quote: clenched fists can break their jaws

couplets.plain: The worthy are of use at a word. The low, like sugarcane, are of use only when crushed.
couplets.pm: When the weak go and simply tell their need, the high take pity and give what they have. The low, like sugarcane, give only when the strong press them until they yield. He names the high as well to show how low the low are.
couplets.sensitive: says the low must be beaten to yield

links.quote: like sugarcane, are of use only when crushed

couplets.plain: When the low see what others wear and eat, they can always find a fault in them.
couplets.pm: When a low man sees others wearing silk and eating rice with milk because of their wealth, he can’t bear it and can make up a fault where none exists. Wearing and eating stand for adorning, riding and the like. Inventing a fault that sounds true is hard, so this is a skill. This is envy of others’ wealth.

links.quote: they can always find a fault in them
links.reason: The mere sight of what others wear and eat sets the low hunting for faults.

links.quote: When the low see what others wear and eat

couplets.plain: What are the base good for? When something happens to them, they are fit to sell themselves, quickly.
couplets.pm: When any trouble comes to the base, they are fit only to seize on it and quickly sell themselves to others. What other work are they fit for? It takes only some small thing, not even hunger, and they hurry before the buyer learns what they are and says no. They end as others’ slaves.

ideaLinks.quote: The worthy are of use at a word. The low, like sugarcane, are of use only when crushed.
ideaLinks.reason: Sets those moved by a word against those moved only by crushing.
